note: Daily news scan. Official sources first: numbers in a news post must be checked against an official page (RBI, PIB, Income Tax, GST council, NPCI, SEBI) before they go on a slide. News sites are for finding stories, never for the numbers.
score_rule: Pick a story only if it changes what a typical person pays, earns or saves, and the change can be shown with a calculation (e.g. EMI on a ₹50 lakh loan, tax on a ₹12 lakh salary). Market moves (Sensex up 200 points), company results and political statements do not qualify.
blocked_for_the_fetch_tool: Mint, Economic Times, BusinessLine, Moneycontrol (blocked); PIB RSS (fails). Use WebSearch for these instead.
